autonomous_wave.goal: Prevent concurrent File Provider imports, cancellation, storage pressure and staging recovery from overcommitting disk or deleting active partial/ready snapshots by adding durable staging ownership and reservation through downstream validation.
autonomous_wave.rationale: AW15 made provider bytes snapshot-coherent but age-only recovery could still sweep a long-running active file, multiple importer instances could preflight the same free-space snapshot, and process death/downstream validation had no durable ownership contract.
autonomous_wave.done_when: Each production provider import owns a durable reserved staging lease before copy, recovery respects active/corrupt leases, progress/cancellation/ENOSPC and partial-to-ready retarget fail closed, downstream validation maintains keepalive ownership, portable tests/self-check/evidence pass from committed sources, and Apple/device/PARITY gates remain explicit.
autonomous_wave.next_priority: Close the remaining AW10 exporter publication -> registration-intent crash micro-gap with an IO-owned durable publication/recovery intent, unless the next fresh lane audit identifies a higher current-iPhone PARITY/correctness gap; Apple File Provider/storage runtime remains HQ-gated.
